abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we identify that the key criterion for determining whether a model is truly capable of novel view synthesis (NVS) is transferability: Whether any pose representation extracted from one video sequence can be used to re-render the same camera trajectory in another.

evidence.anchor: the key criterion for determining whether a model is truly capable of novel view synthesis (NVS) is transferability

abstract_sentences.text: We analyze prior work on self-supervised NVS and find that their predicted poses do not transfer: The same set of poses lead to different camera trajectories in different 3D scenes.

evidence.anchor: their predicted poses do not transfer: The same set of poses lead to different camera trajectories

abstract_sentences.text: Here, we present XFactor, the first geometry-free self-supervised model capable of true NVS.

evidence.anchor: we present XFactor, the first geometry-free self-supervised model capable of true NVS

abstract_sentences.text: XFactor combines pair-wise pose estimation with a simple augmentation scheme of the inputs and outputs that jointly enables disentangling camera pose from scene content and facilitates geometric reasoning.

evidence.anchor: combines pair-wise pose estimation with a simple augmentation scheme

abstract_sentences.text: Remarkably, we show that XFactor achieves transferability with unconstrained latent pose variables, without any 3D inductive biases or concepts from multi-view geometry — such as an explicit parameterization of poses as elements of SE(3).

evidence.anchor: achieves transferability with unconstrained latent pose variables, without any 3D inductive biases

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce a new metric to quantify transferability, and through large-scale experiments, we demonstrate that XFactor significantly outperforms prior pose-free NVS transformers, and show that latent poses are highly correlated with real-world poses through probing experiments.

evidence.anchor: introduce a new metric to quantify transferability, and through large-scale experiments
NVS has emerged as a canonical 3D computer vision problem; can it be formulated without multi-view geometry?
we identify transferability as the key property of any novel view synthesis model
existing methods do not infer transferable camera poses, and are instead prone to interpolating context frames
preventing the model from interpolating by bootstrapping from a two-view NVS model
we then fine-tune the two-view XFactor model into a multi-view model
true NVS across diverse, large-scale real-world datasets at both the scene and object level
we introduce a metric for quantifying the degree to which novel views adhere to reference poses
forcing the model to parameterize camera poses as SE(3) is harmful
In summary, we make the following key contributions
We introduce transferability as the key criterion and introduce the True Pose Similarity metric
bootstrap multi-view NVS on top of a two-frame model which, by design, always extrapolates
novel self-supervised NVS training objective which explicitly promotes transferability
the first fully self-supervised NVS model to achieve transferability
merits of our formulation in comprehensive large-scale experiments and ablations
We review prior work on novel view synthesis with and without known camera poses
Oracle, Semi-Oracle, and Geometric Methods
the same set of predicted poses renders different camera trajectories in different 3D scenes
we instead focus on the specific problem of recovering transferable camera pose representations
Given a sequence of images I of a static scene, existing NVS methods partition context and target images
three core components: a pose encoder, a scene encoder, and renderer
the pose encoder maps ... to sets of latent pose representations; the scene encoder converts ... to S
the model is trained to minimize what we call the autoencoding objective
the ORACLE ... spits out the ground-truth camera poses as elements of SE(3)
the prevailing framework ... is ill-suited for the self-supervised setting
the same camera pose always results in the same viewpoint being rendered
pose representations ... are transferable ... if the latent representations ... and renderer satisfy
This criterion automatically satisfies the autoencoding objective ... when IA = IB
we introduce a standardized metric ... True Pose Similarity (TPS)
leveraging TPS to measure whether their camera trajectories agree
this quantity only measures one component ... it is necessary to pair it with a perceptual measure
training such a self-supervised multi-view model leads ... to interpolate context views
by providing RENDER with only a single image for reconstruction we eliminate the interpolation path
guide optimization toward learning transferable pose representations
pose encoder to encode information about target pixels ... cheat by decoding pixel information
randomly generating two equal-area masks whose union covers the whole image
an explicit SE(3) parameterization ... degrades it compared to an unconstrained stereo-monocular baseline
Combining the stereo-monocular model with the transferability objective gives rise to XFactor
Both POSE_ENC and RENDER are implemented as multi-view VITs
extend it to a multi-view model by fine-tuning ... the reference image ... is chosen to be the frame with the minimum maximal baseline

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 NVS 的可控性重写为跨场景 pose transfer；用 stereo-monocular 去掉 interpolation，再用低像素重叠的 pose-preserving augmentation 将 transferability 写入 loss，最后 fine-tune 成 multi-view XFactor（p.4–9, Eqs. 5–12, Tables 1–3）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 transferability 定义、TPS caveat、two-view bootstrap、Eq. 11/12、主数据／基线、transfer/probe/ablation 证据；它们承担方法决策与主结果判断（p.4–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: ViT/token 实现、optimizer、采样 baseline、GPU 时长、autoencoding、masked inference、SSL/temporal/oracle robustness、artifact 案例移入 p.13–17；实现复现依赖 Appendix B，判据理解仍可由正文完成。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 用统一的 input-output 行为标准统领定义、训练和评测；以 Figure 1 与 Tables 1–3 分离行为、表示和组件证据；Eqs. 10–12 将直觉压缩为可执行训练机制（p.5–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “first”优先性无法由本文内检索穷尽；interpolation、rendering facilitates reasoning、deterministic artifact 的因果解释缺少独立 intervention；oracle fragility、artifact 与统计／复现缺口延后或未报告（p.4, p.9–17）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对无显式状态表示的生成任务，先定义跨内容实例可复用的 input-output 行为，再把该行为写成 paired training objective，并分开报告行为 metric、representation probe 与 content fidelity（p.4, p.8–9）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则要求能构造保持控制量且降低内容重叠的 paired observations；控制量不可保持、场景随时间变化、目标多模态或 proxy oracle 易受 corruption 时，须补充任务特定、生成式或多样性验证，不能只凭 transfer score（p.4, p.6, p.15–16）。
